name: AA Simple Paypal
author: AA Extensions

sections.description:
This plugin is created to ensure your payment in paypal. It is very easy to use. Just use this shortcode to show your paypal button in anywhere in website.

Features

  1. Generate PayPal payment buttons using a shortcode.
  2. Supports both Live and Sandbox (Test) PayPal environments with a toggle option.
  3. Allows one-time payments and subscription (recurring payment) support.
  4. Includes shipping cost option for payment forms.
  5. Customizable payment button styling via CSS classes.
  6. Supports specifying quantity, custom fields, return and cancel URLs in the payment form.
  7. Admin panel shortcode generator under Settings > PayPal Button for easy shortcode creation without manual coding.
  8. Validates and sanitizes user inputs to ensure security and data integrity.
  9. Lightweight and minimal dependencies to keep site performance optimal.

How to use it

Go to Settings > PayPal Button in WP Admin to generate the shortcode easily.

Use this shortcode

[aapaypal email=”sandbox@example.com” item_name=”Test Product” amount=”10″ sandbox=”yes”]

[aapaypal email=”live@example.com” item_name=”Pro Membership” amount=”49.99″ sandbox=”no”]

Version

1.0.1
sections.installation:
1. Install as regular WordPress plugin.
  2. Go your plugin setting via WordPress Dashboard and find “AA Simple Paypal” activate it.
